subject: Operator access matrix & SCIM sync run-through

From: Olivia Park <olivia@acme-corp.com>

Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Operator provisioning questions for Private Control Plane

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the demo last week. Before we sign the PO we need to validate how operator provisioning and identity sync will work for Private Control Plane (VPC deployment). A few specific asks from our security team: 

- SCIM: we need a canonical field map (group -> RBAC role mapping) and an understanding of delta sync cadence and conflict handling. Does Redwood support SCIM bulk patch and incremental sync?
- SAML: Can SAML assertions be mapped to named roles (not just groups)? We want SAML attributes to carry role, tenant_id, and account_type.
- Service accounts: Recommended lifecycle (rotation schedule, expiration, owner).
- Audit: retention guarantees for admin-role changes and SCIM provisioning events (we need at least 12 months).

Can you share a proposed operator access matrix and the SCIM field mapping? Prefer a quick workshop this week if possible.

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Head of Security
Acme Corp

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Operator provisioning questions for Private Control Plane

Hi Olivia —

Appreciate the clear list. I've attached an initial operator access matrix (privcp_operator_matrix_v1.csv) and an SCIM field mapping workbook (acme_scim_field_map.xlsx). Quick answers up-front: 

- SCIM: Redwood Private supports SCIM 2.0 with both bulk patch and incremental delta. By default we run incremental every 5 minutes and a full reconciliation nightly; cadence is configurable. Conflict resolution uses last-write-wins at the attribute level with an option to prefer your IdP as the source of truth.
- SAML: yes — assertions can carry a role attribute which maps directly to RBAC entries; we support role and tenant_id mapping with claim transformation rules in the control plane.
- Service accounts: we recommend 90-day rotation, minimum 1y audit retention for creation/rotation events, and scoped permissions per operator role.
- Audit: Redwood retains admin-role-change logs and SCIM provisioning events for 12 months by default in Private; we can extend per contract.

Can Marcus and Laura join a 45-min workshop Thursday to walk the SCIM mapping and verify the operator matrix against your internal roles? Proposed slot: Thu Apr 22 10:30–11:15 PT.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0123

Hey team — following up from the workshop. Recap and technical details below (pulled from the demo notes):

1) SCIM behavior and recommended config:
- Delta cadence: default 5m incremental, nightly full sync. If Acme's directory pushes high churn (>5000 updates/day) we recommend increasing incremental to 1m and enabling event-driven hooks.
- Bulk Patch: supported via PATCH /Users and PATCH /Groups; we support multi-valued attribute replace semantics per RFC 7644.
- Conflict policy: attribute-level LWW; optional SCIM precedence flag to prefer IdP or Redwood.

2) Field mapping (highlights from the workbook):
- scim:Groups.display -> redwood:rbac_group
- scim:User.emails[type eq "work"].value -> redwood:primary_email
- extension:tenant_id -> redwood:tenant_id (must be present on user assertions)
- custom attribute:role -> redwood:explicit_role (preferred over group mapping when present)

3) SAML mappings and assertions:
- We support mapping SAML attribute 'role' -> RBAC name; when both group and role are present we use explicit_role precedence.
- Assertion examples attached in the workbook. Note: for on-prem IdPs that don't support complex attributes, we recommend using a small bridging service that converts group claims into extension attributes.

4) Service accounts & lifecycle:
- Creation: service accounts are namespaced under a customer tenant and must be owned by an internal approver.
- Rotation: recommended automatic rotation every 90 days; we can enforce rotation via exp claim on tokens.
- Expiry: default expiry = 365 days for non-human tokens; removable via API.

5) Auditing & retention:
- Control plane stores provisioning events, SCIM patches, and role changes with full diffs. Retention 12 months by default; archived exports to S3 for longer retention available.

6) Hardening recommendations for Private (VPC):
- SCIM endpoint over mutual TLS. We recommend mTLS with client certs rotated every 6 months.
- Lock down the SCIM endpoint to Acme CIDR ranges and require source IP allowlisting.
- Provide a read-only service account for security to query audit logs via our API.

Action items:
- Jordan: share updated operator matrix with explicit tenant_id and role columns (I updated v1 — see attached).
- Olivia: confirm whether your IdP can emit 'role' as a top-level attribute or if you need the bridge pattern.
- Laura: prepare a scoped service-account template for security to start testing.

-- Marcus
Marcus Lin
Staff Systems Architect | Redwood Inference
